description: This is a PHP source file defining the Currency controller class within the Opencart system, specifically the startup namespace for the catalog. It manages currency selection and session cookies for currency preferences in the OpenCart e-commerce platform.

classes.name: Currency
classes.description: Controller class responsible for managing currency settings, including loading currencies, updating session data, and cookies based on user selection.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method that loads available currencies, determines the current user-selected currency from session, cookies, or config, updates the session and sets cookies accordingly, and registers the currency in the registry.
